Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every stationary solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Step 2. Consider the normal operator \(P_{01320012}\) acting on the Kahler manifold. By the normal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|P_{01320012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320012\).

Step 3. Applying the bounded interpolation theorem to \(Q_{01320013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Wavelet interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
